text.p: These the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Syria welcomes Iraqi athletes who were excluded from the Pan Arab Games in Beirut.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs cabinet meeting which discusses some economic aspects.
- Some 23 trucks laden with 55,000 tonnes of French wheat in their way to Iraq from Jordan.
- Editorial and articles on the 39th anniversary of July 14, 1958 Revolution.
